user.title: Select AC Infinity controller
user.description: Close the AC Infinity phone app before connecting. The controller accepts only one Bluetooth client.

error.device_disappeared: The controller is no longer visible. Close the phone app and try again.

abort.no_devices_found: No AC Infinity Bluetooth controller was found during the 12-second scan. Force-close the phone app, verify the controller appears under Settings > Bluetooth > Advertisements, and try again.
abort.not_supported: The discovered advertisement is not a supported AC Infinity controller.
